style.toneOfVoice: This contemporary Christmas garland is the perfect decoration to celebrate the festive season with something a little different yet still making an impressive feature. Boasting a sugarplum pink and snowy white colour scheme for a modern move away from traditional palettes, the natural garland is lovingly crafted from winter woodland treasures. Real foraged pinecones and bundles of mossy twigs pair beautifully with delicately curled wooden roses, iridescent berries and shimmering baubles to give the pink garland a luxurious finishing touch. Each decoration is carefully attached to the robust wire frame, ready for you to display it in place over your mantelpiece or woven through your staircase perhaps. L120cm Size: ONE.
